What We Do

Complete Plumbing &
Heating Solutions

From a dripping faucet to a full heating system overhaul, Northline handles it all. No job too small, no emergency too late at night.

Emergency Repairs

Burst pipe at 2am? Flooding basement? We answer the phone and dispatch a tech fast — day, night, weekend, or holiday. No after-hours surcharge for the call itself.

Learn more

Water Heater Service

Tank and tankless water heater installation, repair, and replacement. Most swaps completed same day. We carry major brands and size the unit correctly for your home.

Learn more

Boiler Maintenance & Repair

Annual tune-ups, pressure relief valve testing, zone valve replacement, and full boiler overhauls. We service all major makes including Weil-McLain, Burnham, and Peerless.

Learn more

Bathroom Rough-In

Planning an addition or basement bath? We handle all rough-in work: drain, vent, and supply lines stubbed in before the walls close. Code-compliant, inspected, and ready for your tile guy.

Learn more

Drain Cleaning & Hydrojetting

Slow drains, recurring clogs, and full blockages cleared with professional-grade cable machines and high-pressure hydrojetting. Kitchen, bathroom, and main-line drains.

Learn more

Leak Detection & Repair

Hidden leaks behind walls, under slabs, or in the yard. We locate the source with non-invasive equipment and make the repair the right way — no unnecessary tear-out.

Learn more

Our Story

37 Years of Keeping
Grand Rapids Running

Walt Holstrom started Northline in 1987 with one truck and a promise: treat every customer like a neighbor, not a ticket number. His son Dave and daughter-in-law Karen took over in 2011, and that same philosophy drives every job we take.

We're not a franchise. We don't have a call center in another state. When you call us, you reach someone who knows Grand Rapids — and someone who will actually show up when they say they will.

  • Upfront pricing — written estimate before any work begins
  • All technicians background-checked and uniformed
  • 1-year labor warranty on all repairs
  • We clean up completely before we leave
